title: Three Mornings and One Short Cup
subtitle: 身体健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）
meta: 主题语境：身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）　|　核心词汇：lip　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 lip 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 the nurse ① moistened the lip that no patient in the ward would have recorded, and he said the moistening was the whole of the morning. The ② lip, meaning the edge itself and not the cup, ran three mornings and stayed unrecorded in the book; a lip, he said, is the only thing in a ward that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ lip in that ward had the same short cup beside it, and the ④ lip at the far bed, meaning the word they kept for the children to catch and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A lip, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the nurse said the recording is the part that fills three mornings.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the lip was the whole of the matter, meaning the smile and not the edge. The ⑥ lip, meaning the smile and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; lip, he said, is either something you moisten or the only word that means both an edge and a smile. He said the smile is the part they remember.

By 1982 the ⑦ lip had become a line in a chart, and the chart had become an argument about the short cup. The ⑧ lip of the whole thing, the nurse wrote in February, was one ward and three mornings of recording; lip, he said, is either the word at the far bed or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ lip I remember is the edge recorded in the chart, which closed in 1984 and is still recorded as the quietest in the ward. A ⑩ lip, my mother said in 1986, is the only edge that improves by being recorded; every lip, she said, is a smile that has agreed to look like an edge. She said the smile was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 嘴唇；唇（指病房里每一片旁边的那一片）
B. n. 嘴唇；唇（指那片嘴唇本身，与杯子相对）
C. 固定搭配：moisten the lip 润湿这片嘴唇
D. n. 嘴唇；唇（指留给孩子们听清的那一句那一片）
E. n. 唇齿之事（抽象总称，指一处病房的嘴唇之事）
F. n. 嘴唇；唇（指护理记录里写到、被记载的的那一片）
G. n. 笑意、口风（指一件事里人人都说却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 口风（抽象总称，指人人都说却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: moistened the lip that no patient in the ward would have recorded
The lip, meaning the edge itself and not the cup
the lip at the far bed
the lip was the whole of the matter
the lip had become a line in a chart
The lip of the whole thing
A lip, my mother said in 1986

answers.why: moisten the lip 意为“润湿这片嘴唇”，1977 年那位护士把病房里没有一位病人肯记载的一片嘴唇做了一遍。
lip 意为“嘴唇；唇”，指那片嘴唇本身而不是杯子，它经过了三个早晨而在簿子上没有被记载。
lip 意为“嘴唇；唇”，指病房里每一片旁边的那一片，每一片旁边都有同一只小小的杯子。
lip 意为“嘴唇；唇”，指最远那张床边留给孩子们听清的那一句那一片，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
lip 意为“笑意、口风”，指一件事里人人都说却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份笑意就是那件事的全部。
lip 意为“口风”，指人人都说却无人提起的那样东西而不是那片嘴唇，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
lip 意为“嘴唇；唇”，指护理记录里写到、被记载的的那一片，到 1982 年这一片成了护理记录里的一行。
lip 意为“唇齿之事”，护士二月写道，整件事的嘴唇之事是一处病房和三个早晨的记载。
lip 意为“嘴唇；唇”，我记得的是护理记录里记载过的那一片，1984 年润好了，至今仍被说成病房里最安静的一片。
lip 为抽象总称，母亲 1986 年说，嘴唇是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的嘴唇。

最远那张床边那片嘴唇，指的是他们留给孩子们听清的那一句那一片，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（lip）
叔叔说这份笑意就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那片嘴唇。（lip）
